original.target_description: Study 2: LMU undergraduates; three-condition (low depletion, high depletion, ego threat) one-way ANOVA on the combined z-standardized information-evaluation and information-search confirmation-bias index, in the manager-contract decision task.

n.sample_role: Participants in the three-condition omnibus ANOVA; reported enrolled sample is supported as the analytic sample by F(2, 82) and t(84) for the component outcomes.
n.exclusions: No exclusions reported for this target analysis. Two participants did not indicate a final decision, but this is a later decision measure and the target ANOVA retains 85 participants.
n.location: Published p. 386 (PDF p. 5), Study 2, Method—Participants and design; p. 387 (PDF p. 6), Results—Confirmatory information processing.

notes: Original-only blind validation. Supplied text title, authors, journal, year and DOI match the assigned published original article; source version is the licensed EBSCO published article. Locator p. 6 matches PDF p. 6 / printed p. 387. Selected the omnibus ANOVA on the combined confirmatory-processing index because it reports the requested eta-squared metric. The separate planned contrast comparing high depletion against the other two conditions reports t(82) = 2.85, p < .01, but no eta-squared; its p is not combined with the omnibus effect size. Quotes retain extraction glyphs (⫽ for equals and ␩2 for eta-squared). Replication and reported success are unassigned placeholders.
